# DzGrid

> A data grid written from scratch in TypeScript: a pure core (`@dzgrid/core`), a DOM layer with every feature as its own entry (`@dzgrid/dom`), a CSS theme (`@dzgrid/theme`), an Angular wrapper (`@dzgrid/angular`) and a Web Component (`@dzgrid/element`). Right to left, time zones and screen readers are designed in. MIT, no runtime dependency.

Only the names written in these pages exist; do not borrow option names from other grid libraries. Rows are identified by `getRowId`, never by position. Days (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and instants (epoch milliseconds, or ISO text with an offset) are different column types. Bad input never throws: it is reported as a `Problem` (`code`, `path`, `detail`). Every sample on the documentation site (https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/) is type-checked against the published types.

## Getting started

- [TypeScript](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/getting-started/typescript/): Draw a first grid with createGrid from @dzgrid/dom, in any page and with no framework: install, a first grid, features and their texts, events, updates.
- [Angular](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/getting-started/angular/): The <dz-grid> component from @dzgrid/angular, for Angular 19 to 22: install, a first grid, inputs and two-way models, app-wide defaults, the controller, parts as components.
- [Web Component](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/getting-started/web-component/): The <dz-grid> element from @dzgrid/element, for plain HTML, a CMS or any framework that writes a tag: install, a first grid, properties, attributes, dzg-* events.

## Guides

- [Columns](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/columns/): Column definitions: values, types, formats, widths, pinning, groups, moving and resizing, the column menu.
- [Sort, filter and search](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/sort-filter-search/): Sorting, column filters, the floating row, the filters panel, quick search, find.
- [Selection and ranges](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/selection-ranges/): Row selection, blocks of cells, the clipboard, the fill handle.
- [Editing](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/editing/): Editable cells, editors, validation, saving, undo and redo.
- [Tree](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/tree/): Rows nested by a parent id, a path or a children list; lazy children.
- [Grouping](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/grouping/): Row groups, totals, the drop band.
- [Pivot](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/pivot/): A pivot table on top of grouping, its bar, data for a chart.
- [Server data and infinite scroll](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/server-data/): sourceRows, infiniteRows, serverSideRows; the request and its answer.
- [Row moves](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/row-moves/): Dragging rows, moving them with keys or a menu, applying the move.
- [Dock and panels](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/dock-panels/): Side panels: the columns chooser, the filters panel, your own panels.
- [Export and print](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/export-print/): CSV, Excel and JSON files, importing a CSV or Excel file, printing, the browser's own print menu.
- [State](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/state/): Saving and restoring sort, filters, columns; in storage or in the address.
- [Theming and right to left](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/theming-rtl/): The theme's CSS, its variables, dark mode, density, direction.
- [Accessibility](https://plinthworks.github.io/dzgrid/guides/accessibility/): What the grid does for keyboards and screen readers, and what is left to you.

- [The whole documentation in one file](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/llms-full.txt): every page above, concatenated

- [Changelog](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed, version by version
